purpose: Read-only nonexpert boundary observability audit; preserves why no new source M01 or additional GS stage can be run. Not an action benchmark, model performance test, or technical grade.

scope_counts.not_additive_note: MIT72 overlaps initial MIT16 by13 originalframes; ATP425 context overlaps the dense51. Counts describe review passes and are not summed as unique data.

initial_cases.observation: Full demonstrator is visible in the reviewed first swing, but opponent/feed stroke is outside the shot. Incoming ball appears only after body/racket turn. Existing M03 remains M03.
initial_cases.sampling: 16 sparse frames 0..45; no exhaustive absence claim

initial_cases.observation: Additionally reviewed every original frame 9..33. Feet/body pivot and a forward step are visible; no unambiguous split-step landing was established. A clearly visible incoming ball occurs at frame 32 after the turn/backswing, so it cannot be moved earlier to create an M01 interval. Opponent is off-screen.
initial_cases.source_title: PE.710 Tennis, Spring 2007, Prof. Carol Matsuzaki
initial_cases.original_dataset_policy: single-handed backhand remains parameter-held-out; no thresholds or algorithm choices were fitted to it

initial_cases.observation: Opponent/feed stroke is outside the shot. Single-player preparation, feet adjustment and backswing are visible, but they do not establish the original opponent-release boundary. Existing M03 remains M03.
initial_cases.sampling: 15 sparse frames 0..42; no exhaustive absence claim

initial_cases.observation: Self-slice drill with successive close/front/rear shots. Several reviewed shots clip the lower legs/feet; the rear shot shows standing foot adjustment but no established opponent incoming-ball to split-step landing sequence. Self-generated ball control is not a complete match GS04 M01.
initial_cases.sampling: 12 sparse frames 980..1200; edited shots never joined

initial_cases.observation: Standing explanation and shadow forehand-slice demonstration. No opponent hitting or incoming-ball context appears in the reviewed sequence. Widening stance during the demonstration is not a verified split-step endpoint.
initial_cases.sampling: 12 sparse frames 1380..1545; not a full-source exhaustive review

initial_cases.observation: Court overview includes the distant opponent; every original frame 135..170 was additionally reviewed. Opponent swing then departing/approaching ball are visible, but near player chiefly shifts/lifts the left foot while right foot remains near its support position, then turns. A complete split-step landing endpoint was not independently established. Do not promote the old detector FS candidate to an M01 label.
initial_cases.sampling: 12 sparse overview frames 0..330 plus all 36 frames 135..170; no conclusion about all 97 seconds

initial_cases.observation: Player and feet are visible during repeated groundstroke preparation/recovery, with camera following the player, but opponent ball departure is outside the shot. Ready-posture dips or foot adjustment cannot supply the missing original M01 start.
initial_cases.sampling: 14 sparse frames 0..195 within the previously observed 204-frame first shot

atp.observation: Both players are visible. Near player gathers feet/hops then separates feet and bends knees; far player executes a return. Exact departing-ball and shoe-contact instants remain uncertain at source resolution.
atp.independent_review_note: Reviewed six native crop sheets and397/398/399/400 full PNGs without preload values. Ball can be tracked departing around399..402, but contact pixels insufficient; boundary brackets overlap. Cannot independently establish positive-length complete source M01.
atp.rejected_extensions: Do not extend endpoint into404..410 lateral movement or418 preparation merely to reach7frames.

usopen.observation: Near player whole-body view; no opponent contact visible in these existing shot contexts.
usopen.decode_note: OpenCV source-frame seeks returned frames; one h264 mmco warning was printed. No exact phase annotation derives from those context frames.

sequential_decode_png_byte_verification.method: Decode original video sequentially from frame 0; PNG encoded bytes equal the frozen context PNG hashes; no media rewrite.

stages.reason: 对手/喂球者出球不在画面；不能以准备下蹲或旧 M03 替代原始起点。

stages.source_start: 左右脚重新接触地面（垫步落地）
stages.reason: 原始起点要求垫步重新接地；本次动作未建立该落地事件，不能把普通脚步调整作为起点。

stages.source_start: 开始完成单位转体，肩线开始旋转，非持拍手辅助球拍整体转动，
stages.source_end: 重心成功加载至持拍手同侧支撑腿，重心完成侧向转移，支撑腿承重稳定，为主动蹬地做准备
stages.reason: 既有人工 M03 几何代理保留原身份；本轮未新增或重标，承重与主动发力并未被证实。

stages.source_start: 重心成功加载至持拍手同侧支撑腿，支撑腿承重稳定，身体完成蓄力姿态|J：J070 J077 J146 J166；S：S013；K：K050 K060 K080
stages.source_end: 骨盆开始主动旋转，骨盆角速度明显增加，动力链开始向前上方传递
stages.reason: 可见躯干/腿部转动，但起点的支撑腿稳定承重和蓄力、终点的骨盆主动旋转与向前上方传力无法由二维画面证实；未以膝角变化替代蹬地。

stages.source_start: 支撑腿主动蹬地完成，骨盆开始主动旋转,动力链开始向前上方传递| J：J070 J071 J072；K：K080 K081
stages.source_end: 肩髋分离达到最大值，胸廓开始主动旋转，肩髋分离角达到峰值，胸廓开始接管动力链
stages.reason: 支撑腿主动蹬地完成及动力传递不可见；单视角肩线/髋线投影不能独立确认真实肩髋分离达到峰值或胸廓接管动力链。

stages.source_start: 肩髋分离达到最大值，胸廓开始主动旋转
stages.source_end: 持拍手开始主动加速，球拍进入释放准备状态
stages.reason: 起点要求真实肩髋最大分离及胸廓主动旋转；终点要求持拍手主动加速/释放准备。二维手腕移动和拍下落不能确认主动性或独立标定两端。

stages.source_start: 持拍手开始主动加速，球拍进入释放准备状态
stages.source_end: 球拍轨迹与预测击球轨迹开始收敛
stages.reason: 既有人工前挥/加速代理边界单独保留；本轮没有以其三相窗口均分十阶段，也未新增 M07。

stages.source_start: 球拍轨迹与预测击球轨迹开始收敛
stages.reason: 球在39–40帧从拍附近向外移动可见，但起点的球拍与预测击球轨迹收敛无法直接观察；不能用可见球离拍反推完整 M08。

stages.source_end: 非持拍手重新接触球拍
stages.reason: 球离拍可见候选39–40；非持拍手于41–43向拍柄/持拍腕汇合，但432×240像素与遮挡不足以确认实际接触球拍还是持拍腕，原始终点未建立。不得延长至52回拍身前凑帧。

stages.source_start: 非持拍手重新接触球拍
stages.source_end: 左右脚重新接触地面，身体建立稳定准备姿态
stages.reason: 原始起点为非持拍手重新接触球拍，未得到确认；60–62可见宽站位/拍身前的准备形态，不能据此证明鞋底接地和受力，也不能补造缺失起点。

independent_visual_review.limitation: Nonexpert; no new numerical result read. Hand-to-racket contact cannot be distinguished from hand-to-wrist overlap; shoe contact/force is not established. Candidate brackets are not stage annotations.
